name: MIDI Clock / Retro Precision
status: High-fidelity raster design proposal; not implemented UI or editable Figma source

prompt_specifications.visual: Create one cohesive UI visual board with dark full, light full and compact dark macOS windows. Refined retro scientific instrument style: amber seven-segment 128.0 BPM, flat graphite panels, 1px rules, 4px corners, minimal texture/shadow. Master-first layout with two following devices at 128 BPM and one stopped independent sampler at 90 BPM. Preserve theme selection, global Stop, per-device modes and responsive layout. Clear Chinese labels, modern body typography and monospaced auxiliary labels.
prompt_specifications.components: Create a matching six-section UI component board: paired light/dark semantic colors and typography; tempo display default/editing/focus/error; transport default/hover/pressed/disabled/focus; following/independent/offline device rows; status and reduced-motion beat indicators; theme/mode menus and responsive dimensions. Do not imply external clock confirmation.

dimensions.units: macOS logical points; px labels in concept board are illustrative

interaction_rules: Master affects followers only; independent devices retain separate tempo and transport.
Start is disabled for an already playing device or fully playing follower group. Stop is disabled when its target is stopped. Global Stop is disabled when nothing is playing.
Stopping means every visual beat segment is unlit; reduced motion uses a static indicator.
Beat indicator is a UI view of locally scheduled clock, not an external-device synchronization acknowledgement.
Tempo digits can use seven-segment rendering in display mode; editing must remain a real accessible text field with selection and caret.
The entire tempo field exposes a numeric BPM accessibility value; individual digital segments are hidden from accessibility.
Theme supports system, light and dark; mode supports follow master and independent.
Global stop and theme remain reachable in compact layout; remaining controls wrap and scroll, not scale down.
Light-theme amber is confined to the dark display; text and small action icons on light surfaces use dark amber #8A4B00.
Validate contrast at implementation: normal text >=4.5:1, large text and essential nontext controls >=3:1.
Use text plus icon for all status changes; never color alone.
image_corrections: Light master Start in visual board must be disabled because master is playing.
Any active-looking Stop on a stopped sampler must be disabled.
Remove any decorative USB MIDI dropdown: the product does not have a global USB transport selector.
Component board compact <=380 label is illustrative and incorrect as a breakpoint: compact mode is width <580, minimum width is 380.
Dark theme is not forced default: follow system is the default.
Reduced motion and stopped are separate states: reduced-motion playing may use static active status; stopped has no lit segments.
Image text, swatch hex strings and gradients are illustrative; use these explicit values and flat surfaces, not sampled pixels.
